title: Sony Launches GTA 6 Themed DualSense Controllers
subtitle: The two models, black and white, arrive in November with pre-orders starting September 10
excerpt: Sony has unveiled two GTA 6-inspired DualSense controllers, featuring an iridescent finish and palm tree details.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Sony announced, during the State of Play, two exclusive DualSense controllers for the upcoming Grand Theft Auto VI. The announcement coincides with the game's release date reveal and has generated significant interest among fans.

Vice City-Inspired Design

The models – Black Limited Edition and White Limited Edition – replicate Vice City's visual identity. Each controller features an iridescent finish that changes color with the lighting and molded palm leaf relief on its surface. The official GTA 6 logo is prominently displayed, reinforcing the connection to the game.

Release Date and Pre-order

Pre-orders begin on September 10, at 10 AM local time, in selected markets. The launch is scheduled for November 19, 2026, the same date announced for the arrival of GTA 6.

Price and Availability

The suggested price for both controllers is 84.99 euros, with equivalent values in dollars and pounds depending on the region. So far, Sony has not released specific details on pricing or availability in Brazil, indicating that local information should be announced closer to the pre-order date.

Technical Features Maintained

Despite the distinct look, the controllers retain all standard DualSense functionalities, including haptic feedback and adaptive triggers. Sony states that these features will be utilized in GTA 6 to convey physical sensations during gameplay, such as trigger resistance in specific situations.

Use on Other Platforms

In addition to PlayStation 5, the limited edition can be used on PC, Mac, and mobile devices, allowing collectors to enjoy the exclusive design across various gaming environments.

With information from Estadão, 4gnews.
